sections.Profile:
The "Universe" pinball machine, designed by Wayne Neyens and released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in 1959, is an electro-mechanical game featuring a sci-fi theme.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1959
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Women, Backbox Gimmick, Wood Rail, Space, Original Theme, Rockets, Sci-Fi
